evidence.notes: Search.find groups deterministic fixed local search rows by sObject type.
SearchResult exposes the local SObject row found through Test.setFixedSearchResults.
SearchResult exposes the deterministic local snippet string.
Field-specific snippets are accepted for shape and return local snippet text when present.
KnowledgeSuggestionFilter records local DTO filter inputs without calling an external suggestion service.
QuestionSuggestionFilter records local DTO filter inputs without calling an external suggestion service.
Search.suggest returns an empty deterministic SuggestionResults DTO.
Local suggestion DTO reports no additional external results.
Empty local suggestion result DTO returns null SObject.

name: data-platform-search-result-suggestion-dtos
salesforceExclusionReason: Search suggestion results require an org-indexed Knowledge/search corpus; the scratch org has no portable Knowledge data, so the hosted assertion is data-dependent. Retain deterministic local search DTO proof and exclude hosted runtime.

source.content: @isTest private class SearchResultSuggestionDtosTest { @isTest static void resultAndSuggestionDtosUseLocalRows() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Nook Trail'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); Search.SearchResults found = Search.find('FIND {Nook} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH SNIPPET'); List<Search.SearchResult> accountResults = found.get('Account'); System.assertEquals(1, accountResults.size()); Search.SearchResult row = accountResults.get(0); Account foundAccount = (Account)row.getSObject(); System.assertEquals(account.Id, foundAccount.Id); System.assert(row.getSnippet() != null); System.assert(row.getSnippet('Name') != null); Search.KnowledgeSuggestionFilter filter = new Search.KnowledgeSuggestionFilter(); filter.addArticleType('FAQ'); filter.addDataCategory('Products', 'Trail'); filter.addTopic('Cabin'); filter.setChannel('AllChannels'); filter.setLanguage('en_US'); filter.setDataCategories(new Map<String,String>{ 'Products' => 'Trail' }); filter.setPublishStatus('Online'); filter.setValidationStatus('Validated'); Search.KnowledgeSuggestionFilter filterOther = new Search.KnowledgeSuggestionFilter(); System.assert(filter.equals(filter)); System.assert(!filter.equals(filterOther)); System.assert(!filter.equals(null)); Integer filterHash = filter.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, filterHash); System.assertEquals(filterHash, filter.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, filter.toString()); Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter questionFilter = new Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter(); questionFilter.addGroupId('0F9GROUP0000001'); questionFilter.addNetworkId('0DBNETWORK00001'); questionFilter.addUserId('005USER00000001'); questionFilter.setGroupIds(new List<String>{'0F9GROUP0000002'}); questionFilter.setNetworkIds(new List<String>{'0DBNETWORK00002'}); questionFilter.setTopicId('0TOtopic0000001'); questionFilter.setUserIds(new List<String>{'005USER00000002'}); Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter questionFilterOther = new Search.QuestionSuggestionFilter(); System.assert(questionFilter.equals(questionFilter)); System.assert(!questionFilter.equals(questionFilterOther)); System.assert(!questionFilter.equals(null)); Integer questionHash = questionFilter.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, questionHash); System.assertEquals(questionHash, questionFilter.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, questionFilter.toString()); Search.SuggestionOption option = new Search.SuggestionOption(); option.setFilter(filter); option.setLimit(3); Search.SuggestionOption optionOther = new Search.SuggestionOption(); System.assert(option.equals(option)); System.assert(!option.equals(optionOther)); System.assert(!option.equals(null)); Integer optionHash = option.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, optionHash); System.assertEquals(optionHash, option.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, option.toString()); Search.SuggestionResult suggestionType = new Search.SuggestionResult(); Search.SuggestionResults suggestionResultsType = new Search.SuggestionResults(); System.assertNotEquals(null, suggestionType); System.assertNotEquals(null, suggestionResultsType); Search.SuggestionResults suggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Knowledge__kav', option); System.assertEquals(0, suggestions.getSuggestionResults().size()); System.assertEquals(false, suggestions.hasMoreResults()); for (Search.SuggestionResult suggestion : suggestions.getSuggestionResults()) { System.assertNotEquals(null, suggestion.getSObject()); } } }
